guards.description: Gateway auth precedes all MCP handlers. No unauthenticated/default-public attack claim and no invented OAuth audience gap.
No runtime test, measured crash, deployed secret or host-audit claim. External controls require evidence.

evidence.quote: Host audit, framing limits, ingress policy and process supervision require host evidence.

guards.description: Recognize Map lookups and async rejection forwarding; do not allege the inherited-key or uncaught rejection defect.

coverage.description: Assess GET session lookup and error handling, not just file presence.
Assess DELETE lookup and error handling separately or explicitly verify equivalent enforcement.
Resolve declared host entrypoint and distinguish application module from external transport implementation.
Assess POST initialization: random session creation and storage of the external transport, behind the shared gateway gate.
